bounded_route_disposition.rule: A completed bounded source disposition need not mean every row has a ready source. NO_EXECUTABLE_SOURCE_ROUTE_VERIFIED_UNDER_DECLARED_TOOLS_AND_CAP is a limit of this bounded attempt, not proof that data do not exist or that the user cannot access them elsewhere.
bounded_route_disposition.tool_check: No BigQuery, Allium, Athena or Snowflake query/export tools were exposed by name/description discovery. No account, credential or signed-in session was probed. The generic anonymous HTTP archive route is separately usable for documented public S3 sources.
